summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on the cipher-box web app, implementing fixes and closing threads.
summary.outcome: Fixed two valid review issues (hover state CSS override and unmounted component timer leak), committed, pushed, and resolved all threads.

repo: Upload UI state (error, complete, progress) is managed in apps/web/src/stores/upload.store.ts via setFileStatus
Upload row styling lives in apps/web/src/styles/upload.css with row-level state classes
Completion auto-removal logic belongs at the store level, not in individual components, to avoid lifecycle dependency

code.finding: Hover styles were overriding error/complete row backgrounds; fixed by scoping hover with :not(.error):not(.complete) selectors
setFileStatus is the right place to trigger completion cleanup timers — ensures they fire even if the component unmounts before the timeout
Component-level completion timer was removed after moving the logic to the store; component no longer needs to manage its own cleanup

workflow: GraphQL reviewThreads query used to fetch and filter unresolved PR threads before triaging
REST endpoint used for replies (with --field for integer in_reply_to), GraphQL mutation used to resolve threads
typecheck + unit tests run before commit to validate fixes
